title: koeleria asiatica subsp. ledebourii
intro: Koeleria asiatica subsp. ledebourii, commonly known as Koeler's grass, is a plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Koeleria asiatica subsp. ledebourii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
